candidates: Unsafe Optional.get() call without isPresent() guard in RecoveryAuthnCodeInputLoginBean.java line 19 will throw NoSuchElementException if no credential exists, while the same utility call in RecoveryAuthnCodesFormAuthenticator.java properly guards with isPresent() check

Dual-path credential creation creates security inconsistency: createRecoveryCodesCredential sends raw (unhashed) recovery codes to user storage via UserCredentialModel.challengeResponse, while the local credential provider fallback stores hashed codes. This means federated storage recovery codes are not hashed at rest while local storage hashes them.
